description: This file provides a utility function 'inferColumns' for generating column configurations for a DataTable component based on row data and an allowlist. It processes dataset objects to determine which fields to include as columns, handles special formatting for date fields, and ensures only relevant columns are shown.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Generates an array of column definitions for a DataTable, based on provided dataset rows, an allowlist of field names, and optional configuration options including date fields.
